definitions.explanation: A person who is traveling, especially for leisure or sightseeing. Emphasizes the person's role as a customer or visitor.

examples.japanese: {旅行客|りょこうきゃく}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{賑|にぎ}わっている→賑わう：14235_nigiwau⟧。
⟦{外国人|がいこくじん}→外国人：02869_gaikokujin⟧{旅行客|りょこうきゃく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{年々|ねんねん}→年々：10417_nennen⟧⟦{増|ふ}えている→増える：01183_fueru⟧。
examples.english: The number of foreign tourists is increasing year by year.

examples.japanese: ⟦{京都|きょうと}→京都：09484_kyouto⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{春|はる}→春：00627_haru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{旅行客|りょこうきゃく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{桜|さくら}→桜：02212_sakura⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{目当|めあ}て→目当て：13648_meate⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{大勢|おおぜい}→大勢：02850_oozei⟧⟦{訪|おとず}れる→訪れる：07678_otozureru⟧。
examples.english: In spring, many travelers visit Kyoto to see the cherry blossoms.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{旅行|りょこう}→旅行：00748_ryokou⟧ (travel) and ⟦{客|きゃく}→客：00865_kyaku⟧ (customer/guest). Views the traveler from the perspective of the tourism or hospitality industry — as a customer or visitor.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{外国人|がいこくじん}→外国人：02869_gaikokujin⟧{旅行客|りょこうきゃく}: foreign tourist
- {旅行客|りょこうきゃく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}える→増える：01183_fueru⟧: tourists increase
- {旅行客|りょこうきゃく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{呼|よ}び{込|こ}む→呼び込む：06087_yobikomu⟧: to attract tourists
- {旅行客|りょこうきゃく}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{賑|にぎ}わう→賑わう：14235_nigiwau⟧: to be bustling with travelers

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{観光客|かんこうきゃく}→観光客：03022_kankoukyaku⟧: sightseer; tourist — focuses on sightseeing specifically; the most common word for tourist
- ⟦{旅行者|りょこうしゃ}→旅行者：22927_ryokousha⟧: traveler — more neutral; does not carry the "customer" nuance of ⟦{客|きゃく}→客：00865_kyaku⟧
- ⟦{旅人|たびびと}→旅人：12725_tabibito⟧: traveler — literary or poetic; evokes a wanderer or journeyer
